name: University of Montpellier statutes
summary: Cardinal Conrad of Urach issues statutes for the medical school at Montpellier, formalising what had been a loose community of physicians teaching under Salernitan and Arab influence since the late 12th century. Honorius III grants Studium Generale recognition in 1289.

_quarry.structural_significance: Earliest formal medical university in the Latin West; Montpellier's strong contact with Arabic medicine via the nearby Jewish community shapes the medieval European medical curriculum.
